verdict.headline: Warsh warns inflation battle isn't over, turning September rate hike into a coin flip
verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — September hike now ~50%; SPX -0.25% to 7,712; 30Y at 5.19%, 11bps from trigger; BTC failed $80K breakout
verdict.rationale_short: Warsh's Jackson Hole debut was unambiguous: inflation 'still too high,' the Fed 'has more work to do.' September hike odds jumped from ~33% to ~50-60% in one speech, and the 10Y rose 5bps to 4.70% with DXY ticking up to 99.47. The S&P fell a contained -0.25% and VIX actually dipped to 14.51 — orderly, not a rout — but that calm surface conceals a real regime shift. The 30Y sits at 5.19%, 11bps from the 5.30% trigger. BTC's false break — spike to $81,500 intraday through the $80K ceiling, reversal to $77,848 (-2.97%) — is the clearest risk-off tell of the session. MRVL AH -7.45% and RBRK AH decline extend the altitude-rejection pattern across AI infrastructure. Into Monday: the AI earnings tailwind from Thursday provides a floor, but do not add risk. Reduce into any strength. The September coin-flip is a persistent new overhang.

trade_setups.thesis: Warsh shifted September hike odds from ~33% to ~50-60% in one speech. The 30Y closed at 5.19%, 11bps below the regime trigger. Any further hawkish catalyst — hot CPI next month, an FOMC speaker corroborating Warsh, or a strong NFP — could close that gap in a single session.
trade_setups.entry: 30Y above 5.25% is the warning zone; above 5.30% is a formal regime breach. Hedge via SPX downside or long TLT puts if 30Y trades into the 5.25-5.30% band. Current position: 11bps of buffer.
trade_setups.invalidation: 30Y drops back below 5.10% on soft data or a clearly dovish FOMC speaker before September meeting.

trade_setups.thesis: Five attempts, five failures. The intraday spike to $81,500 and -4% reversal to $77,848 is a textbook bull trap. Warsh's hawkish tone reduced the macro bid. The Bessent BTC buyback (Sep 9) is a known support event but may not be enough to overcome the rate headwind.

bear_case: Friday's orderly decline is masking a real regime inflection. Warsh was unambiguous — the Fed is not done, September is live, and rate-hike odds moved 20+ percentage points in a single speech. The 30Y is 11bps from the 5.30% trigger. BTC's failed $80K breakout (spike to $81,500, reversal to $77,848) is the sharpest risk-off signal crypto has sent in five sessions. MRVL and RBRK's AH declines extend the altitude-rejection pattern; if this spreads to NVDA and AVGO when they next report or face a technical re-test, the AI-earnings floor weakens simultaneously with a rate-pressure ceiling tightening. If Monday opens risk-off and the 10Y trades through 4.75%, the SPX should find the 7,650 level; a close below that breaks the post-August-24 recovery structure and shifts the read to full bearish.
